description: Company product announcement with no request. Informational only. Must NOT produce an attention item.

messages.raw:
From: Example Software <news@example-software.example>
To: demo@local.test
Subject: We have launched offline mode for the desktop client
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 12:00:00 +0000
Precedence: bulk
List-Unsubscribe: <mailto:news@example-software.example>
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"

We are pleased to announce that offline mode is now available in the 4.2 release of
our desktop client.

Offline mode caches your projects locally so you can keep working without a
network connection, and changes are synchronised when you reconnect. We have also
improved startup time and reduced memory use in long-running sessions.

You can read the full release notes in the documentation. Existing installations
will update automatically on next launch.

Nothing is required from you. If you would prefer to manage updates manually,
the preference is available under Settings.

The Example Software Team
